headline: Kai, overloaded routers stopped every U.S. departure for four hours Friday, and the weekend opens with more than 6,600 cancellations.
subline: Markets mostly shook it off — the S&P 500 still rose 2.5% this week — but a hot annual PPI kept December-hike bets alive and bitcoin slid to $67,000.
asof: Weekend edition · strip shows Friday's close, Nov 13 (gold is Friday spot; bitcoin is live, ≈6:50 AM ET Sat) · every figure links to its source below

items.title: S&P 500 slips Friday but gains 2.5% on week
items.sentence: The index closed at 7,561.67 Friday, down 0.4%, while the Dow added 0.1% and the Nasdaq fell 0.9%, per the AP's market wrap — and all three still finished the week up 2% or more.

items.title: October PPI comes in mixed; December hike stays priced
items.sentence: Wholesale prices rose 0.3% against the 0.4% economists expected, per Yahoo Finance, but the 6.5% annual rate was the largest since November 2022 and the 10-year yield touched 5.17% before ending near 5.15%.

items.title: Gold steadies after touching a 13-month low
items.sentence: Spot gold traded near $3,891.50 Friday, up 0.39% on bargain hunting after Thursday's rout, per Kitco, with futures pricing roughly 89% odds of a quarter-point hike at the December 8–9 meeting.

items.title: WTI holds near $89 as Iran premium fades
items.sentence: WTI settled at $88.92 and Brent at $96.08 on Friday, per the Rio Times, with a 4.7-million-barrel U.S. crude build and rising yields capping the war premium.

items.title: Next week: Nvidia Tuesday, Fed minutes Wednesday, Walmart Thursday
items.sentence: Analysts expect Nvidia to report about $109 billion in quarterly revenue, up 91%, per CMC Markets, with U.S. retail sales Tuesday and the October Fed minutes midweek rounding out the calendar.

items.title: FAA ground stop cancels thousands of weekend flights
items.sentence: The nationwide stop ran from 3:54 to 8:15 p.m. ET Friday after switches and routers 'got overloaded with data,' per ABC News, and Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy — describing a system running on 'analog telecom' — asked Congress for billions to modernize it.

items.title: US mediates Ukraine-Russia working-level talks in Abu Dhabi
items.sentence: Envoy Steve Witkoff said the sessions cover post-war security arrangements, de-escalation and next steps toward peace, per CBS News, with European allies and NATO joining separate consultations on security guarantees.

items.title: Alaska's Senate race heads toward ranked-choice tabulation
items.sentence: Mary Peltola leads Dan Sullivan 49.2% to 47% with 91.3% of ballots counted, per Yahoo News, and if neither clears 50% the ranked-choice count begins November 18 — a Peltola win would give Democrats 56 seats.

items.title: Brooklyn collapse developer avoided stricter oversight, Times reports
items.sentence: The New York Times found 2625 Bedford Avenue was approved as a three-story project — below the seven-story threshold that requires a site-safety coordinator — before the collapse that killed eight, per Google News' daily digest.

items.title: Pope Leo draws 500,000 at Mass in Chiclayo
items.sentence: Vatican News put attendance at Pampas de Pimentel at about half a million Friday as Leo returned to the Peruvian diocese he led until 2023, per Google News' daily digest.

items.title: Anthropic aims to price its IPO and trade next week
items.sentence: The company plans to set its valuation range this week and begin trading Thursday or Friday, per a Wall Street Journal report cited by TechCrunch, with some institutional investors pushing for less than the $1.5 trillion previously discussed.

items.title: Treasury and Commerce clash over Nvidia's suspect buyer
items.sentence: Scott Bessent pressed Howard Lutnick on why Megaspeed — a Singapore firm suspected of routing an estimated $4 billion in Nvidia chips toward China — is still off the Entity List, per AI Weekly, while Commerce denies the confrontation happened.

items.title: Open letter asks Nvidia's board to reinstate Huang
items.sentence: A 'Stand With Jensen' letter with more than 7,000 self-reported signatures urges reinstating the former CEO pending an investigation, per ExplainX's roundup, and the board has not responded.

items.title: Cursor details Claude Code extension backdoor and cleanup
items.sentence: Tampered builds 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 sat in Cursor's marketplace for about 11 hours on October 29 attempting to install SSH backdoors, per Cursor's security notice, which includes check-and-remediate scripts for affected machines.

items.title: Bitcoin slips to $67,000 as hike bets firm
items.sentence: Bitcoin trades near $67,068, down 2.6% over 24 hours per CoinGecko, extending Friday's first drop below $70,000 in nearly three months as December rate-hike expectations hardened.
